title: MEIKO — With A Soothing Fragrance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... I've already had a chance to see band me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I promised Luka that we'd go over to see the idol versions of us later...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I think I'll go over to see that SEKAI again...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, I need a cafe au lait and a cream soda. I'll take this orange juice and juice mix over to Len and Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Need some help, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm okay. Just sit tight.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's so nice of you to offer her a hand.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We probably wouldn't help even if they asked us to♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seriously? I feel like you should help someone out if they ask.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Especially considering how many drinks and dishes they've made for you guys.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You two are so much more mature than them. Anyway, here's your orange juice and your juice mix.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They're all at the cafe today.
Things seem to be fun and lively...
MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome back.
You went over to see a show in that other SEKAI, yes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it was fun, exciting and full of surprises.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They even performed a bunch of cool magic tricks and stuff♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, now I regret going over to see another SEKAI instead of following you two.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They're apparently doing more showings of it for a little while, so you should still have plenty of chances to see it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? In that case, it might be good to invite the others along.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, great idea!
And don't forget to invite me, because I wanna see it again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyway, MEIKO, what were you doing just now? You mentioned something about seeing various different places today...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I decided to go see how I was doing at the cafe before heading over to see my idol self.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And everybody was there.
It felt so lively.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Until not too long ago, Luka and KAITO didn't really visit much. But now, it's like they're there all the time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they are.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the Luka and me from that SEKAI didn't actually introduce themselves to Kohane and the others for a very long time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Lemme think... I vaguely remember KAITO talking to MEIKO about rice omelets or something...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Rice omelets...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He noticed that she didn't have them on the menu and said that he'd come back when she added them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I-Is that true...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Meanwhile, Luka kept wandering around the back alleys because of how they felt like a fun maze.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
Those two really are free spirits...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But none of the other versions of you are really like them, so watching them is always fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others do sort of have a habit of pushing themselves too hard, so those two could help remind them that it's important to take breaks every now and then.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I hope you're right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, those two being a bit of a handful will keep the me of that SEKAI more than busy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think she became the barista that she is because KAITO is such a stickler when it comes to coffee.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, didn't she practice by brewing batches and batches of coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She did.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It seems that she likes to do her very best for others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which must mean running a cafe is her calling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And I hope you keep being the person that everybody looks to for help.)
